title: Remove identity-pool full CRUD from Assignment and MessageThread
description:
amplify/data/schema.ts:889 (Assignment) and :1489 (MessageThread) grant allow.authenticated("identityPool").to(authoringOperations), where authoringOperations = read, create, update, delete (schema.ts:11-16). The identity pool must exist for guest reads, so any signed-in Cognito user (reader, curator) can mint SigV4 credentials and create, rewrite or delete assignments and forum threads. The editor group itself is limited to read and create on Assignment.

Fix: delete both identityPool rules. Lambdas already have access via allow.resource(...); editors must go through the protected assignmentAction mutation. Check that the typed copy in amplify/data/resource.ts matches. Verify with the newsroom Assignments tab (claim/release/complete still work through assignmentAction) and a sandbox deploy on Ryan's Mac.

Done when: no identityPool rule on Assignment or MessageThread in either schema file, scripts/test-schema-parity.ts passes, and an authenticated non-editor cannot delete an Assignment.

Source: full code review of develop @ e9b1923 on 2026-10-17 (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/f01a3c9f-7fad-4df2-8a15-ac6c27cc83ed). Branch from origin/develop, name the branch after this issue, open a PR into develop, and record branch, PR link and verification in a comment here before closing.
